headline: 《小老弟》Netflix喜劇 評論正反分歧
context: Netflix 喜劇《Little Brother》由 Eric André 與 John Cena 主演，一份評論認為既不夠怪也不夠好笑，另一份說粗俗但有笑點。曼徹斯特 Aviva Studios 同週上演向 Sinéad O'Connor 致敬的舞蹈演出《The Surge》，10 位女舞者以肢體詮釋她的音樂。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The surreal comedian struggles to sell a middling and mostly conventional film about an uptight realtor whose life is upturned by an unpredictable figure from his past The specific, unforced strangeness of Eric André’s comedy hasn’t been an easy fit for Hollywood. His surreal and frequently hilarious late-night series The Eric André Show was an unpredictably odd and often violently catastrophic mix of awkward celebrity interviews and daring, dangerous on-the-street pranks and his manic, anything-for-the-bit energy marked him as someone execs would be unwise to entirely ignore. But André didn’t really feel like someone who desperately needed industry approval and broader acceptance or the inevitable comedy vehicle that would come with it (those projects are also admittedly far less common than they once were). There was an attempt in 2020, a hidden camera hybrid comedy called Bad Trip that saw André lead a fictional narrative playing out in real locations with real people unwittingly cast alongside. But Covid forced a theatrical play into a Netflix premiere and while it had its moments (the zoo-based sexual assault is a work of crude genius), the format was a gamble that, for me, didn’t completely pay off (it was as hit-and-miss as a sketch show). The film’s looseness did at least feel like a more natural fit for André than his follow-up for the streamer, the far more conventional and far less amusing comedy Little Brother, the closest he has come to “fitting in”. sources.summary: Aviva Studios, Manchester The late singer gets a thrilling tribute from a cast of 10 dancers in Sonya Tayeh’s heartfelt show ‘I’m just a troubled soul who needs to scream into a mic now and then,” said Sinéad O’Connor. Troubles and screams both sing out in The Surge, an ode to her by American choreographer Sonya Tayeh. The singer, who died in 2023, attracted both worship and scorn in her lifetime. The Surge is an act of devotion – 10 women sit on pews, swaying, sliding and indeed surging around them. They leap up, circle and shudder as the songs possess them – moved and inspired, they might be dancing in tongues. Continue reading...

thread_text:
Netflix 喜劇《Little Brother》今週上架，評論意見有點分歧。

Eric André 和 John Cena 主演，故事是一個拘謹的房地產經紀人被一個來自過去的意外人物打亂了生活。一份評論說 André 的特異喜劇感跟這部傳統劇情片格格不入，既不夠怪也不夠好笑；另一份說粗俗，但確實有笑點。

曼徹斯特 Aviva Studios 同週有另一件：向 Sinéad O'Connor 致敬的舞蹈演出《The Surge》，10 位女舞者以肢體詮釋她的音樂。O'Connor 於 2023 年離世，評論稱這場演出「狂野而縈繞心頭」。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 6 月 25 至 26 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
Netflix 喜劇《Little Brother》今週上架，評論分歧。

Eric André 和 John Cena 主演，故事是一個一板一眼的房地產經紀人被過去一個意外人物打亂了生活。一份評論說，André 的特異喜劇感和這部傳統好萊塢劇情片格格不入，既不夠怪也不夠好笑；另一份說粗俗但有些笑點，整體正面。

曼徹斯特 Aviva Studios 同週有向 Sinéad O'Connor 致敬的舞蹈演出《The Surge》。10 位女舞者以肢體詮釋她的音樂，O'Connor 於 2023 年離世，評論說這場演出像「狂野而縈繞心頭的守靈」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 6 月 25 至 26 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
Netflix 上架了部新喜劇《Little Brother》，由 Eric André 和 John Cena 主演。評論意見分歧——有人說既不夠怪也不夠好笑，有人說粗俗但有趣。總之是部走傳統路線的好萊塢喜劇。

曼徹斯特同週有場向 Sinéad O'Connor 致敬的舞蹈演出，10 位女舞者以肢體詮釋她的音樂。O'Connor 在 2023 年過世，評論說這場演出有種縈繞不去的力量。
